description: The wire names of tools with a source (ADR-0006, tool-offer.json#/$defs/wireName): names kept as they are, names in which a character was replaced (a dot, a colon, an accented letter) or which passed 64 characters, each given its suffix, and two names that differ only in a replaced character (issues.list, issues_list), which get different wire names. collisions: two declarations whose wire names are still the same (a name that spells out another's suffix); the package withholds both. held: own names a source's tool may not bear (a Runtime tool, a reserved name, load_tool, propose_pack); the package withholds each. Written by hand; the suffixes are the first 8 hex digits of the SHA-256 the rule names. toolSources.test.ts and go/context hold wireName and the declaration to each row, and the contract tests compute each.
